claim: Patchline ships a cost-optimal autoscaling policy with a proven throughput-per-dollar lower bound. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate then re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the throughput-per-dollar claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make cost-optimal-autoscaling-gate`.
